name: 7-Pieces Outdoor Dining Unit with Wood-Top Table and 6 Side Chairs
material: alu frame w/t powder coated.w/t teslin fabric and WPC board tabletop
description: A classic natural style outdoor dining unit, suitable for your terrace, balcony, patio, and all the other outdoor occasions. The chair is composed of an aluminum frame with a teslin fabric or plastic wood seat, and the backrest is designed with an ergonomic angle. The chairs can be stacked and stored at the same time, saving you more valuable outdoor space. The dining table also uses an aluminum frame and teak wood board as tabletop, which is simple and durable, all this unit is suitable for long-term outdoor use.
